name: byedpi
recipe_basis: Upstream Makefile SRC (packets, main, conev, proxy, desync, mpool, extend). win_service.c is not compiled; src/byedpi.c stubs register_winsvc. main is renamed byedpi_main and signal byedpi_signal (a no-op), so the engine never installs process signal handlers.
patches: Applied to the extracted copy in OUT_DIR, never to the archive; each site must match exactly once. All targets: on_accept checks fastcord_stop_requested (the waking connect stops the engine; upstream's SIGINT shutdown does not wake WSAPoll on Windows). MSVC only: four C99 variable-length arrays become _alloca or a fixed 33-byte buffer.
msvc_compat: native/compat: msvc.h (force-included: ssize_t, strcasecmp, __attribute__), strings.h, and getopt.h/getopt.c, a small getopt_long that supports the optind rewinding byedpi's option groups use.
license_file: LICENSE inside the archive; reproduced in docs/THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md
